useCases.title: Call Center Support App
useCases.description: An AI-powered voice agent that listens, understands, and resolves customer calls end-to-end — not just chatbots that hand off tickets.
capabilities: Speech-to-text captures live caller audio in real time
Text-to-speech responds naturally over the phone
Unlocks locked customer accounts after secure verification
Updates account details such as contact info, preferences, and plan changes
Answers FAQs and policy questions from your knowledge base
Escalates only complex cases to human agents with full call context

useCases.title: AI Agent Tier-1 Support
useCases.description: Deploy AI agents that independently resolve Tier-1 customer support cases — password resets, order status, billing questions, and routine requests — so your human team focuses on complex escalations.
capabilities: AI agents handle and close Tier-1 tickets without human intervention
Resolves password resets, account unlocks, and access issues
Answers order status, billing, and policy questions from your knowledge base
Routes Tier-2 and Tier-3 cases to the right human queue with full context
Works across chat, email, and ticketing systems
Cuts Tier-1 support volume and response times at scale

reviews.quote: The RentAIAgent platform revolutionized our asset deployment cycles. We were able to spin up autonomous leasing agents within days, drastically improving response times.
Implementing the LangGraph Email Harmonization Engine solved a decade-long inbox categorization bottleneck. Truly incredible architectural delivery by the Surve engineering squad.
With custom deployments housed strictly in our Canadian AWS instance, we didn't sacrifice any compliance mandates while gaining massive automation yields.
The architectural exploration phase alone saved us months of research. They possess absolute clarity on where agent technology handles real scale and where it falls short.
